prompt: A pizza is cut into $8$ equal slices from the center. What is the central angle of one slice, in degrees?
hint: All the way around the center is $360^\circ$.

hints.text: All the way around the center is $360^\circ$.
Eight equal slices share that $360^\circ$ evenly.

explanation: A full circle around the center measures $360^\circ$.
Equal slices means equal central angles: $360 \div 8$.
Each slice has a $45^\circ$ central angle — and its crust is a $45^\circ$ arc.

alternativeExplanations.title: Halve, halve, halve
steps: Cut the pizza in half: $180^\circ$ each. Cut again: $90^\circ$ each.
Cut once more for $8$ slices: $45^\circ$ each.
